ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment.
   B. Use Environment to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Environment has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Environment with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of care for plants? (1 mark)
   A. Use care for plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing care for plants.
   C. Say care for plants has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected surah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected surah.
   D. Say Selected surah has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: responsibility? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: responsibility with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on: responsibility to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on: responsibility has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: responsibility.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

8. Which response best shows understanding of Early life of the prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Say Early life of the prophet has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Early life of the prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Early life of the prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Early life of the prophet.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick.
   B. Apply the teaching of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of has no place in daily life.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on:Honesty to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Honesty.
   D. Say Hadith on:Honesty has no place in daily life.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: Respect? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: Respect.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: Respect with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on: Respect has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on: Respect to insult classmates of other faiths.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Believe in? (1 mark)
   A. Use Believe in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Believe in has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Believe in.
   D. Apply the teaching of Believe in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

----
